output.summary: A genus of bushy, tuberous herbaceous perennials native to Mexico and Central America. Each colourful, usually unscented flower head consists of many small flowers, with surrounding petal-like rays; nearly every hue occurs except blue. Some stems remain soft, while others become woody and resprout after winter dormancy.
output.edibilityNote: Tubers of some varieties have dietary value; several cultivars are grown in Oaxaca for their large, sweet-potato-like tubers.
